questions.subject: biology
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about the human menstrual cycle.
(A) Menstruation results from the disintegration of the endometrium after the corpus luteum degenerates in a cycle without fertilisation.
(B) Ovulation takes place in the luteal phase of the cycle.
(C) The corpus luteum continues to secrete progesterone throughout the cycle even when fertilisation does not occur.
(D) The secretion of LH and FSH increases gradually during the follicular phase.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below.

questions.subject: biology
questions.stem: In a human female, the secondary oocyte completes its second meiotic division:

options.text: Only when a sperm enters its cytoplasm
Shortly before ovulation, inside the Graafian follicle
At puberty, when the menstrual cycles begin
During foetal life, before the female is born

questions.subject: biology
questions.stem: At implantation in humans, which part of the blastocyst becomes attached to the endometrium, and which part gives rise to the embryo?

options.text: Inner cell mass attaches; trophoblast forms the embryo
Trophoblast attaches; trophoblast forms the embryo
Trophoblast attaches; inner cell mass forms the embryo
Trophoblast attaches; inner cell mass forms the placenta

List-I: (A) Amniocentesis (B) MTP (C) IUI (D) ZIFT
List-II: (I) Transfer of a zygote or early embryo of up to eight blastomeres into the fallopian tube (II) Intentional termination of pregnancy before full term (III) Artificial introduction of semen into the vagina or uterus (IV) Analysis of foetal cells in the amniotic fluid for chromosomal abnormalities
Choose the correct answer from the options given below.

questions.subject: biology
questions.stem: Oral contraceptive pills are taken daily for 21 days in each course. When should the first pill of a course preferably be taken?

options.text: On the fourteenth day, at the time of ovulation
In the luteal phase, after ovulation has occurred
Within the first five days of menstruation
Just before the expected next menstruation

questions.subject: biology
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about two genetic disorders of humans.
(A) In sickle-cell anaemia, valine is replaced by glutamic acid at the sixth position of the beta globin chain.
(B) Thalassemia results from a reduced rate of synthesis of one of the globin chains.
(C) A person with the genotype HbAHbS is a carrier who is apparently unaffected.
(D) Sickle-cell anaemia is an autosome-linked recessive trait.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below.

In the pellet, as viral protein that had entered the bacteria

questions.stem: In a population of seed-eating birds, birds with very small or very large beaks feed efficiently, while birds with medium-sized beaks feed poorly. Which change in the beak-size distribution is expected over many generations?

One narrower peak around the mean beak size
